what.text: This page follows asylum seekers from Guinea in all host countries combined: people who have asked for international protection and are waiting for a decision.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 56626 asylum seekers from Guinea.
The United States hosts the largest share, 31.1%, followed by Angola, France and Canada.

why.text: UCDP records armed conflict over the government of Guinea with the RFDG in 2000 and 2001.
The fact pack records no armed conflict in Guinea in later years, so it does not say why the number of asylum seekers grew.

when.text: UNHCR's series starts in 2000 at 2523 asylum seekers.
The main years of displacement in the data are 2017 to 2020 and 2023 to 2025, and the figure is at its highest at the end of 2025.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took.
These are year-end totals of asylum seekers summed over every host country; refugees from Guinea are counted separately.
